Package org.apache.commons.collections4.functors

Class PredicateTransformer<T>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.collections4.functors.PredicateTransformer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the input and result to the function.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Function<T,Boolean>, Transformer<T,Boolean>
public class PredicateTransformer<T> extends Object implements Transformer<T,Boolean>, Serializable
Transformer implementation that calls a Predicate using the input object and then returns the result.
Since:
3.0
